judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a standardized method for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a technical specification/tool, not a description of the somatomotor dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper proposes MEG-BIDS, an extension of the BIDS standard to organize and share MEG data, describing a general data structure/format rather than introducing this specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MEG-BIDS, the brain imaging data structure extended to magnetoencephalography
